title: Nice Looking Pumpkins
text: Nice Looking Pumpkins. I have always gone all out when it comes to decorating for holidays and seasons. I saw these pumpkins and have to get them. They are a good size - actually a little larger than I anticipated. They're too large for my tiered tray, but great for the mantel or end table. I really like the burlap on the front. The texture of the burlap adds to the aesthetics.
